text:
Ellery & Vane has bought the rights to The Glass Cartographer, the speculative title by Mira Thorne, in a deal completed on Tuesday, according to people familiar with the transaction. Financial terms were not disclosed, but industry sources put the advance at roughly 1.8 million crowns, with world English, audio and first-look screen options included.

The novel, due for spring 2027 release, centers on a mapmaker who charts invisible trade routes across a storm-broken archipelago. Ellery & Vane said it expects strong traction in export markets and a wide audiobook push.

For the sector, the purchase underscores continued appetite for high-concept literary fantasy, especially titles with cross-format potential and international rights upside.
